description: The live triggers on a trade account (account, or the wallet's own): each with its condition in words, the stock's price now and how far it is from firing (in dollars and percent; a guard's LTV now and about where the price takes it to its LTV), whether it holds now (the account's own check) and why not, who set it, its slip, tip and expiry, and the fire transaction anyone may send once it holds. Triggers do not fire while the stock market is shut or the feed has not printed within 25 hours; a price crossed while it is shut (a weekend, a holiday) fires once the market opens again, at the price the feed prints then, within the trigger's slip, and after a gap that price can be well past the trigger's.

account.description: A trade account's address (default: the wallet's own, as its owner; an agent gives its owner's account)

wallet.description: The account's owner (when account is not given)

name: trigger_list
title: A trade account's triggers
